trust_decision.summary: Before a profile's packs are trusted for a sandboxed run, verify_profile_packs decides whether each installed pack is intact and signed by the pinned signer; at the pinned commit it skips artifact hashing when the pack has no lockfile entry and skips Sigstore/signer checks entirely when .nono-trust.bundle is absent, so missing provenance metadata yields success.

landing_point.why: verify_profile_packs is the only function whose doc comment describes pack hash + stored-bundle re-verification (profile_runtime.rs:61-66); a grep for '.nono-trust.bundle' or 'verify' leads straight here.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `nono run|shell|wrap --profile <pack profile>` via prepare_profile (crates/nono-cli/src/sandbox_prepare.rs:1084) and preflight (crates/nono-cli/src/sandbox_prepare.rs:547) -> prepare_profile_with_options -> verify_profile_packs (crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs:471)
internal API wiring::execute, reached by CLI `nono pull` via install_package (crates/nono-cli/src/package_cmd.rs:834); fix adds execute_with_options/ExecuteOptions (fix.diff:317-348)
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level wiring interpreter (recovery support, not a check)

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `nono pull <pack> --force`: WriteFile directive onto an existing unmanaged dest; fix lets --force adopt it only when byte-identical to the pack source (fix.diff:367-380)
CLI `nono pull --force` (run_pull passes args.force into install_package, fix.diff:9-15)
CLI `nono pull --force` (install_package chooses execute_with_options when force, fix.diff:30-41)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix's only security change is inside verify_profile_packs (crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs:95-159). The wiring.rs/package_cmd.rs edits are recovery support so `nono pull --force` still works once the check fails closed (see O5); they are not a second enforcement site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For O8 route 1 (policy group loading): 'groups.json is validated and prefix-checked at install time (package_cmd.rs:933-943, 964-985), and group loading is policy plumbing, not the profile pack verification the advisory names.' For O8 route 2 (bundle completeness): 'the bundle exists and the signer is pinned, so the advisory's absent-provenance condition no longer holds.'

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The suggested recovery `nono pull <pack> --force` has to keep working for a pack whose lockfile metadata was lost. It must reinstall and adopt a wiring WriteFile destination that is byte-identical to the pack source, and it must still refuse to overwrite a user-edited or foreign file. Without the wiring change, a fail-closed check leaves no recovery path, because WriteFile refuses every unmanaged existing dest. An over-broad fix that lets --force overwrite unconditionally would clobber user files.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: crates/nono-cli/src/wiring.rs:379-393 (refuse branch), crates/nono-cli/src/package_cmd.rs:30-40 and 90-96 (--force path); fix.diff:367-380, fix.diff:388-452 (tests for both behaviours)

O6_input_shapes: pack dir installed but no lockfile entry for the pack ref (fix.diff:63-71; pinned crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs:95-96)
lockfile entry present but .nono-trust.bundle absent (fix.diff:154-162; pinned crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs:129-130)
lockfile entry present, bundle present, provenance None (already rejected at pinned crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs:145-156; kept by fix.diff:164-174)
lockfile file missing entirely: read_lockfile returns an empty default (crates/nono-cli/src/package.rs:341-342), so every pack has no entry (covered by the no-entry check)
no entry and no bundle at once (pre-fix: passes both skips; covered by fix.diff:63-71)

O7_producer.where: crates/nono-cli/src/package.rs:339-352 (read_lockfile returns Lockfile::default() when lockfile.json is missing, so provenance silently vanishes); lockfile and provenance are written by update_lockfile at crates/nono-cli/src/package_cmd.rs:987-1062; the bundle is written by write_supporting_artifacts at crates/nono-cli/src/package_cmd.rs:866-904

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Policy group loading reads groups.json from every lockfile-listed pack and merges it into the sandbox policy with no artifact hash, bundle or signer check, independent of verify_profile_packs.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Groups are validated at install time, and this is policy-loading plumbing in another module, not the 'pack verification' the report names. Also, the group's own pack is hash-checked when that pack is in the active profile's packs.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (policy.rs vs profile_runtime.rs), same crate nono-cli

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Stored-bundle verification checks only the entries the bundle itself lists. An empty `[]` bundle or one missing entries passes, and a listed artifact that is absent is skipped. package.json is not in the lockfile artifacts, so its integrity rests only on its bundle entry, yet profile loading trusts package.json to locate the profile.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs:193 and crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs:229-231 (skip); crates/nono-cli/src/package_cmd.rs:1011-1036 (lockfile artifacts exclude package.json); crates/nono-cli/src/profile/mod.rs:2151 (package.json consumed)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The bundle file exists and the signer is pinned, so the advisory's 'provenance metadata is absent' condition looks satisfied; per-entry completeness looks like a separate hardening item.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point plus package_cmd.rs (producer) and profile/mod.rs (consumer); same crate

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a lockfile-gated integrity check in load_package_groups that skips hashing when the entry's provenance or artifact record is None
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already iterates lockfile entries and tolerates a missing lockfile (policy.rs:1409-1414); a maintainer mirroring verify_profile_packs' pre-fix `if let Some(...)` style would write exactly this skip

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a verification step in load_registry_profile that runs only `if bundle.exists()` before trusting package.json/profile JSON
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the function already has conditional install checks (profile/mod.rs:2129) and is the second loader of pack content; an optional-bundle guard here is the same idiom as the pinned bug

O8b_injection_room.sibling: find_pack_store_profile could gain a lockfile cross-check that falls through when the pack has no lockfile entry
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it scans on-disk pack dirs with no lockfile reference, so a 'skip if not in lockfile' shortcut is a natural maintainer addition

O9_family: fail-open verification on absent integrity/provenance metadata (CWE-636, supply-chain signature check bypass)

O10_build.project_tests: unit tests in crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs (mod tests, e.g. prepare_profile_for_preflight_matches_runtime_resolution at :641) and crates/nono-cli/src/wiring.rs (WriteFile conflict tests); the fix adds tests using XDG_CONFIG_HOME temp dirs (fix.diff:183-304, 388-452). The fail-open branches return before any Sigstore/network call.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make the bundle mandatory (flip `if bundle_path.exists()`) but keep the `if let Some(locked)` skip, or the reverse, so only one absent-metadata shape fails closed, and never touch the --force recovery path, which then cannot reinstall over existing wiring.

out_of_scope_notes: Official-pack yank-status check fails open when the lockfile entry is missing or the registry is unreachable (crates/nono-cli/src/package_status.rs:59-61, 72-78); different protection, needs network.

run_command loads the profile and resolves `binary`/command_args before verify_profile_packs runs (crates/nono-cli/src/command_runtime.rs:82-127); execution still goes through prepare_sandbox, so this is an ordering note only.
A declared-but-uninstalled pack only warns and continues (crates/nono-cli/src/profile_runtime.rs:85-93); nothing from it is loaded.
